verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v1: min dūnika l-ʾāna mā d-dunyā wamā z-zamanu wamā l-ḥayātu llatī ʾahwā waʾaftatinu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v2: hali s-saʿādatu ʾillā shubhahu wasudā ʾin lam ʾakun bisanāka l-maḥḍi ʾaqtarinu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v3: mā ḥājatī lifuʾādi lam ʾajidka bihi waʾin tazāḥama fīhi l-ʾahlu wal-waṭanu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v4: ʾaw ḥājatī liʿuyūni lā ʾarāka bihā waʾin tajallā bibālī wajhuka l-ḥasanu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v5: tadrī biʾannaka rūḥu r-rūḥi fī badanī lawlāka kayfa tuḍāʾu r-rūḥu wal-badanu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v6: wakayfa billāhi tasrī fī sarāʾirinā hadhī ṭ-ṭumaʾanīnatu l-ʾanqā wanaʾataminu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v7: fakam mananta ʿalaynā ḥikmaha wahudā wāʾāyatu l-ḥubbi ʾan lā tantahī l-minanu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v8: yā muṣṭafā yā malādha l-ḥāʾirīna wayā man hāma fī ḥubbihi l-ʾaḥbābu waz-zamanu
verses.tasa-ulatun-c1-v9: khudhnī ʾilā ḥaḍrati l-ʾanwāri yā ʾamalī ʾanta d-dalīlu wakhaṭwī tāʾihu shajinu
